title: 第三章 家里养了鬼都不知道第四章 太平经
lines: 想到就做，正午刚过，王平就换了一身衣服，戴上斗笠，披上蓑衣，又将长长一串的铜钱揣进兜，顺着记忆走出了前村的村口，一路也不耽搁，朝着记忆之中最近的县城，龙兴县的方向走去。
前后又走了约莫一个时辰。
终于，一座城池映入了他的视野——高大的城门，把守的士兵，以及在城外铺开，热火朝天的集市。
这就是“草市”。
汇聚在这里的，九成九都来自县城外的乡野山村，至于县城内的“良民”们，可不会靠近这种地方。
话虽如此，城外草市倒也称得上是“麻雀虽小，五脏俱全”，至少柴米油盐这些生活上的必需品在草市也都能买到，价格甚至还更便宜，最多质量差了点，不过如今的王平也没资格挑挑拣拣。
很快，王平就顺着记忆找到了草市里的米铺。
然而下一秒，他就猛然止住了步伐。
只因米铺门口，一个一身黑衣，腰间佩刀的衙役正冷笑地看着米铺老板，手指轻轻敲着铺里的桌案。
“老陈头，这个月的例钱该给了。”
米铺老板是一个年过四十的老头，脸上满是皱纹，乌发生白，佝偻着腰，闻言赶忙取出了一贯铜钱。
“刘爷放心，都给您备好了。”
说完，米铺老板就要拆开那一贯铜钱，点出足够的例钱数额。
然而下一秒，那个被叫做“刘爷”的高大衙役就猛然伸出手，将整贯铜钱从老陈头的手里抓了过来。
“刘爷！？这.....”老陈头脸色一紧。
“废什么话？”衙役不耐烦地摆了摆手：“就这些了，多出来的扣在下个月例钱，省得浪费我时间。”
话音落下，他又看了一眼米铺的货架，随手将一袋精米取了，揣进怀里，显然也没有丝毫付钱的意思，紧接着更是大摇大摆地前往下一家，所过之处人群纷纷低头避让，根本无人敢与之对视。
俨然是一头积威深重的净街虎。
至于老陈头，也只能报以苦笑。
而在他身后，只见一位年纪在二十岁左右的青年则是目睹了全过程，忍不住咬了咬牙，低声说道：
“这刘扒皮也太过分了.....”
“混账，说什么瞎话！”
此言一出，原本还算平静的老陈头顿时面色大变，赶忙转过身重重拍了青年一下，示意他赶紧闭嘴。
随后见他虽然闭嘴，但依旧满脸怨气，老陈头也只能无奈摇头：
“你还年轻，刘大人已经算是不错的了。”
“不管怎么说，日子还能过，生意还得做......些许委屈，忍忍就过去了，我当年也是你这么过来的。”
远处，王平表情平静地目睹了全过程。
直到那位“刘爷”走完了整条街，满意回了县城，他才走到米铺前，低声道：“陈叔，来半袋精米。”
老陈头闻言当即转过身，一边露出做生意的和气笑容，一边招呼身后青年帮忙，量斗算钱一气呵成。
“共计一百三十三文。”
“陈叔，能抹个零头不？”王平厚着脸问道。
“小哥，我也是小本生意.....”
一番讨价还价后，王平成功替自己省下了一文钱，蚊子再小也是肉，他这才心满意足地付了钱买米。
除此之外，他还得再去买一块炼刀用的精铁。
虽然现在还能用叶片代替，但是想要真正入门【素月莲华刀】，还是得炼制出一口属于自己的飞刀。
content_en:
Just after noon, Wang Ping changed his clothes, put on a bamboo hat and a raincoat, put a long string of copper coins into his pocket, and followed his memory out of the entrance of Qiancun. Without delay, he walked towards the nearest county in his memory, Longxing County.
We walked back and forth for about an hour.
Finally, a city came into his sight - a tall city gate, guarded soldiers, and a bustling market outside the city.
This is the "grass market".
Ninety-nine percent of those gathered here come from rural mountain villages outside the county. As for the "good people" in the county, they will not go near such a place.
Having said that, the grass market outside the city can be said to be "a sparrow that is small but has all the internal organs." At least daily necessities such as firewood, rice, oil, and salt can be purchased in the grass market, and the price is even cheaper. At most, the quality is a little worse, but Wang Ping is not qualified to pick and choose these days.
Soon, Wang Ping followed his memory and found the rice shop in the grass market.
However, the next second, he suddenly stopped walking.
Just because at the door of the rice shop, a government servant dressed in black and carrying a knife at his waist was looking at the rice shop owner with a sneer, tapping the table in the shop with his fingers.
"Old Mr. Chen, it's time to pay this month's payment."
The owner of the rice shop is an old man over forty years old. His face is full of wrinkles, his hair is white, and his waist is stooped. Hearing this, he quickly took out a bunch of copper coins.
"Don't worry, Mr. Liu, everything is prepared for you."
After saying that, the rice shop owner will open the copper coins and count out the sufficient amount.
However, the next second, the tall yamen servant named "Master Liu" suddenly stretched out his hand and grabbed the entire copper coin from Old Chentou's hand.
"Master Liu!? This..." Lao Chentou's face tightened.
"What nonsense are you talking about?" The yamen servant waved his hand impatiently: "That's all. The extra money will be deducted from next month's regular fee, so as not to waste my time."
After he finished speaking, he glanced at the rice shop's shelves again, picked up a bag of polished rice, and put it into his arms. Apparently he had no intention of paying, and then headed to the next shop in a swaggering manner. Wherever he passed, the crowds lowered their heads to avoid it, and no one dared to look at him.
He is like a powerful street tiger.
As for Old Chen, he could only smile bitterly in return.
Behind him, there was a young man about twenty years old who witnessed the whole process. He couldn't help gritting his teeth and whispered:
"This Liu Papi has gone too far..."
"You bastard, what nonsense are you talking about!"
As soon as these words came out, Lao Chentou, who was originally calm, suddenly changed his expression. He quickly turned around and slapped the young man hard, telling him to shut up.
Then seeing that although he shut up, his face was still full of resentment, Old Chen could only helplessly shake his head:
"You are still young, Master Liu is already pretty good."
"No matter what, life can still be lived, and business must be done... I feel a little grievance, and it will pass with patience. You were the same way I came here back then."
From a distance, Wang Ping witnessed the whole process with a calm expression.
It wasn't until "Master Liu" walked the entire street and returned to the county seat satisfied that he walked to the rice shop and whispered: "Uncle Chen, here's half a bag of polished rice."
Upon hearing this, the old man Chen immediately turned around, showing a friendly business smile, while calling for help from the young man behind him, and he finished calculating the money in one go.
"A total of one hundred and thirty-three coins."
"Uncle Chen, can you give me a small change?" Wang Ping asked shamelessly.
"Brother, I also run a small business..."
After some haggling, Wang Ping successfully saved himself a penny. No matter how small the mosquito was, it was still meat. Only then did he pay for the rice with satisfaction.
In addition, he had to buy another piece of fine iron for sword making.
Although leaves can be used as a substitute now, if you want to truly get started with the [Suyue Lotus Sword], you still have to refine a flying knife of your own.
title_en: Chapter 3: I don’t even know there is a ghost in my house Chapter 4: Taiping Jing
